title: Rotten Player
description: Now the player is like a zombie!
body:
**Looking for something new?** _Then try your hand at being a zombie!_
My mod adds:

- Golems and wolves will now kill you without reason
- Villagers now run away from you, and hitting them will restore 1 hunger point
- You're on fire during the day, but safe at night (you know how to protect yourself)
- Infinite hunger

Required [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
